name: Village of Sidi Bou Saïd
description: Sidi Bou Saïd is a clifftop village about 20 km northeast of Tunis, where whitewashed houses with bright blue doors and shutters tumble down a promontory toward the Mediterranean. It grew around the tomb of a 12th–13th-century Sufi saint, and a quiet spiritual atmosphere still lingers among its lanes. Artists have long come for the sea views, and today a short TGM train ride from Tunis brings visitors.
